title: 4 DPWH engineers sacked over corruption, bogus project certifications
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Newly appointed Public Works Secretary Giovanni Lopez has relieved four district engineers over corruption allegations and irregularities involving infrastructure projects…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Newly appointed Public Works Secretary Giovanni Lopez has relieved four district engineers over corruption allegations and irregularities involving infrastructure projects proposed for the 2027 national budget. Three were removed from their posts following “reports of allegations of corruption” committed by district engineers of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH): Hermon Ines
